name: Pilot
tagline: Pilot provides AI-powered bookkeeping, tax, and CFO advisory services for startups and growing companies. Its software automatically categorises transactions, reconciles accounts, and generates financial statements, with human expert review for accuracy. Y Combinator, Sequoia-backed, and thousands of startups trust Pilot for their finances.
